description:
The older guy she’s had a one-way crush on for years vs. the younger guy she can’t stop thinking about… Who will she choose?
June, a political reporter at a newspaper giant, decides to quit her job after her boss turns down her idea for a gutsy and powerful political piece… ...And ends up getting a job offer from her long-time crush who also happens to hold a high position at a massive film company.
She meets the big up-and-coming actor, Tae-Oh, her first day on set and finds his attitude nothing but suspicious. June, giddy from all the time she gets to spend with her crush, Jung-Woo, finds herself blindsided by a proposal from none other than the hot actor himself! 

(Source: Lezhin US)
